name: huddle
description: A covert, invisible-while-screen-sharing call companion: transcribes both sides of a meeting locally, and on a hotkey, asks Gemini for a suggestion.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && npm run build:capture && npm run copy-static
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.capture.json
